required_before_any_update: Parent reviews complete audit.json, both scans and incoming collision records.
Repeat the read-only preservation and exact incoming collision checks immediately before the update if any observed path, branch or remote head changes.
No original-only commit, changed staged entry, dirty incoming overlap, ignored or untracked incoming collision, unstable file read or failed alternate-index dry run may remain unresolved.
Keep every current dirty/untracked file, RLeXplore file, symlink byte, mode and PDF; no stash, reset, forced update or submodule update.

commands_for_parent_review.effect: Only after reviewed gates pass, update this branch by ordinary fast-forward; do not recurse into the dirty submodule or run repository hooks.

commands_for_parent_review.operation: Repeat complete preservation scan and compare dirty/untracked path content, type/mode/link bytes, staged entries, current RLeXplore files and PDFs against the immediate before scan; preserve concurrent changes explicitly. Never restore a file automatically.

commands_for_parent_review.effect: Ordinary non-forced push only after the after-scan confirms preservation; stop if the remote advanced.

scope: This proposal is exact cef3073. A newer target needs a new incoming-path and preservation audit. No command here has updated the original branch, ref, index or worktree.
